Name: Bridget of Sweden
Summary: Swedish noblewoman, mystic and founder of the Bridgettine order, who spent her later years in Rome.
Contribution: Her Revelations were widely read across Europe, her order spread through many countries, and her letters and pilgrimages pressed popes and kings toward church reform and the papacy's return from Avignon to Rome.
Testimony: After her husband's death she devoted herself to prayer, pilgrimage and calling the church to repentance and reform.
